job.title: OMS Lead Engineer
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need an OMS engineer who knows the order flow and the systems around it – I developed and maintained Order Management (OMS) on SAP Commerce Cloud at Shell and drive ERP/MDM integrations at Rockwell Automation.

– 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211), Java and Spring
– Code reviews and technical guidance for junior developers
– Query refactoring that reduced response latency

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for EPAM.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Order Management (OMS) Engineer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with 5+ years building and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Developed and maintained Order Management (OMS), Promotions Engine, Cronjobs and Impex; built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, PIM / ERP / MDM integrations, SQL performance tuning and production troubleshooting. Performs code reviews, mentors junior developers and executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: EPAM delivers complex commerce transformations for global clients, and order management is where reliability matters most. I want to bring my OMS, integration and SAP Commerce depth to a remote-first engineering culture that values technical excellence, code quality and mentoring – the way I already work with international teams today.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, your OMS Lead Engineer role caught my eye: I developed and maintained Order Management (OMS) on SAP Commerce Cloud at Shell and lead integration work at Rockwell Automation. SAP certified, based in Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Happy to talk!

en.subject: Application: OMS Lead Engineer
en.hook: Order management sits at the heart of every enterprise commerce platform, and it needs an engineer who understands both the order flow and the systems around it. I have worked exactly there for more than five years: at Shell I developed and maintained Order Management (OMS) on SAP Commerce Cloud, and at Rockwell Automation I resolve integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and the shop – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: Order Management (OMS)
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules at Shell: Order Management (OMS), Promotions Engine, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts and Hotfolders.

bullets.label: Integrations & APIs
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce and PWA frontends; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP services and resolved bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.

bullets.label: Technical leadership
bullets.text: Perform code reviews, support production issues and provide technical guidance to junior developers; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Performance & delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at EPAM on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
